purpose: Discover distinct Wayback captures of the exact community ZIP URL without CDX and without opening any archived ZIP bytes.
allowed_outputs: distinct snapshot timestamps and URLs in timestamp order
counts of observed anchors, no-snapshot anchors and unresolved transport failures
forbidden: open member names or member payloads in this stage
open economic values or strategy returns
select/refine anchors based on archive contents
use credentials, API keys or account login
successor_rule: If and only if the sweep reveals a distinct snapshot timestamp not already structure-inspected, freeze a bounded ZIP-central-directory inspection for every newly discovered distinct timestamp before opening any member payload.
